summary:
Slack’s hash mark is the icon slack.com sends for workspace pages in the browser. The table is limited to images fetched for this page, with byte size and pixel size taken from each file.

Checked 12 November 2026 against slack.com. HTML came from https://slack.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon 16x16 32x32 48x48 → https://a.slack-edge.com/9cc0056/img/icons/favicon-32.png.

No favicon.ico URL returned an image on 12 November 2026. slack.com did not pass the image check for an .ico path. Formats that did save: png.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #000000 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-35x34-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-35x34-01.png at 35×34 (png, 702 bytes) from https://a.slack-edge.com/9cc0056/img/icons/favicon-32.png.
